title: Idle Clicker
prompt:
Build an idle clicker. Tapping the big coin earns perClick coins. There are exactly three upgrades: 'power' (+1 per click, base price 10), 'worker' (+1 coin per second, base 15) and 'factory' (+8 per second, base 100). After a purchase the price is ceil(base * 1.15^owned). Income accrues every tick as perSecond / 60, so coins and totalEarned may be fractional (display them floored). score = floor(totalEarned). Reaching 1,000,000 earned ends the game as a win. Keyboard: Space clicks, Digit1/Digit2/Digit3 buy power/worker/factory. Touch/mouse: tap the coin and the upgrade buttons drawn on the canvas, which show prices and disable when unaffordable.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, coins, totalEarned, perClick, perSecond, upgrades:[{id, cost, owned}]}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.click(): click the coin
- Game.input.buy(id): returns false when unaffordable
- Game.buttonCenter(name): canvas point of 'coin' or an upgrade id
- Game.debug.addCoins(n): add n to coins and totalEarned

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): clicking, prices and scaling, passive income, win, canvas buttons, keyboard.
